name: Jeht
description: A courageous member of the Tanit tribe in Sumeru who embarks on an emotional and epic journey through the desert alongside the Traveler.

name: Liben
description: A traveling merchant from Snezhnaya who appears during specific events to trade valuable rewards in exchange for common regional materials.

name: Timmie
description: A young boy who spends his days standing near the bridge entering Mondstadt

name: Madame Ping
description: A cheerful elderly resident of Liyue Harbor who is secretly an adeptus and the keeper of the magical Serenitea Pot realm.

name: Dunyarzad
description: A devoted and kind-hearted young noblewoman in Sumeru City who is a loyal attendant and friend of Lesser Lord Kusanali.

name: Taroumaru
description: A clever and business-savvy Shiba Inu who manages the Komore Teahouse in Inazuma City.

name: Rana
description: A Forest Watcher trainee from Sumeru who dreams of protecting her homeland and eventually receives a Vision.

name: Vlad
description: A diligent Fatui guard stationed at the Northland Bank in Liyue Harbor during the daytime.

name: Nadia
description: A polite and romantic Fatui operative working the night shift at the Northland Bank in Liyue Harbor.

name: Sango
description: The sharp-witted and analytical head of the Bantan Sango Detective Agency in Inazuma.

name: Ryuuji
description: A dedicated and earnest detective who works alongside Sango to handle fieldwork and investigations.

name: Lepine-Pauline
description: An anxious and high-strung clockwork engineer from Fontaine who frequently participates in regional mechanics events.

name: Haniyyah
description: A knowledgeable Sumeru researcher who is deeply passionate about the Inter-Darshan Championship and Beast Tamer tournaments.

name: Souka
description: A lively Inazuman citizen who frequently takes part in various cultural festivals and community events across the region.

name: Bongo-Head
description: A friendly and sentient floating Hydro Fungus companion befriended during Sumeru's animal training events.

name: Arama
description: A wise Aranara who sacrifices his memories and existence to help plant a new Ashvattha Tree in Vanarana.

name: Ararycan
description: A helpful blue Aranara who assists the Traveler during the exploration of Devantaka Mountain and the giant Ruin Golem.

name: Arabalika
description: A fiercely powerful warrior among the Aranara known for effortlessly defeating powerful Ruin Machines.

name: Sorush
description: A prideful and arrogant Pari bloomguard who guides the Traveler through the arid wastes of the Realm of Farakhkert.

name: Scylla
description: A magnificent and ancient dragon dwelling within the submerged depths of the Sea of Bygone Eras in Fontaine.

name: Little One
description: A playful and customizable baby Saurian companion who accompanies the Traveler throughout their adventures in Natlan.

name: Caterpillar
description: An articulate, human-shaped Hilichurl researcher who plays a crucial role in the Narzissenkreuz Ordo storyline.

name: Fujin
description: An enigmatic carp adeptus residing in Chenyu Vale who protects the waters and traditions of the region.

name: Ying'er
description: A flirtatious and smooth-talking perfume maker at Fontaine's Perfume shop in Liyue Harbor.

name: Timaeus
description: An earnest alchemist's apprentice working under Albedo near the Mondstadt Alchemy crafting bench.

name: Teucer
description: Childe’s energetic and imaginative younger brother who visits Liyue Harbor and believes that Ruin Guards are simple toys.

name: Mamere
description: A gentle and imaginative Melusine painter living in Merusea Village whose artwork holds a mysterious secret.

name: Pahsiv
description: An endearing Melusine creature residing in the underwater caverns of Fontaine who communicates solely using her own name.

name: Zhiqiong
description: A daring and ambitious cartographer from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild who explores the hazardous depths of The Chasm.

name: Verr Goldet
description: The calm and observant owner of Wangshu Inn who secretly serves as a strategic intelligence agent for Liyue.

name: Chef Mao
description: The warm-hearted owner of Wanmin Restaurant and the proud father of the Pyro chef Xiangling.

name: Aeval
description: A talkative and cheerful Melusine who serves as a tour guide for the Clementine Line aquabus in Fontaine.

name: Elphane
description: A diligent and orderly Melusine who operates the Navia Line aquabus transit system in Fontaine.

name: Talochard
description: An energetic and headstrong Melusine detective associated with the Fontaine Research Institute.

name: Wagner
description: A perpetually grumpy yet exceptionally skilled master blacksmith operating his forge in Mondstadt.

name: Ellin
description: An enthusiastic aspiring Knight of Favonius who endlessly practices combat maneuvers near the Mondstadt headquarters.

name: Anna
description: A former adventurer from Mondstadt who recovers from a severe illness and later joins the Adventurers' Guild as a playable-style NPC.

name: Glory
description: A gentle blind woman in Mondstadt who sits faithfully on a bench waiting for her beloved knight Godwin to return.

name: Godwin
description: A cowardly Knight of Favonius stationed outside Mondstadt who is too ashamed to return after losing his unit.

name: Viktor
description: A Fatui diplomat stationed inside Mondstadt's cathedral who shares insights into the inner workings of the Snezhnayan organization.

name: Cyrus
description: The booming and boastful Branch Master of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild.

name: Grandpa Lu
description: An elderly master carpenter residing in Qingce Village who oversees local woodworking and crafts.

name: Granny Ruoxin
description: The respected and caring community matriarch of Qingce Village who looks after its elderly residents and history.

name: Albert
description: A fanatical follower of Barbara who leads her fan club with an intense and overwhelming devotion.

name: Kujirai Momiji
description: An Inazuman fishing enthusiast who exchanges special weapons and items in exchange for collected fish.

name: Shimura Kanbei
description: The friendly owner of the Shimuraya food stall located right outside Inazuma City's main street.

name: Chang the Ninth
description: A cynical and perpetually stressed web-novel author living a quiet life in Qingce Village.

name: Marjorie
description: The cheerful proprietor of the "With Wind Comes Glory" souvenir shop in Mondstadt.

name: Jifang
description: The knowledgeable and helpful owner of the Wanwen Bookhouse in Liyue Harbor.

name: Gendou Ringo
description: A mysterious shrine maiden handling fortune slips in Narukami Island who conceals a secret past with the Fatui.

name: Masanori
description: An amnesiac rogue samurai wandering Kannazuka who challenges travelers to grueling sword duels.

name: Master Zhang
description: A legendary master blacksmith operating his open-air workshop near the docks of Liyue Harbor.

name: Hajime
description: A proud and traditional blacksmith working at the smithy in Inazuma City.

name: Flora
description: A sweet young flower vendor who runs her floral stall just outside the gates of Mondstadt.

name: Donna
description: A floral assistant in Mondstadt who is well-known for daydreaming and harboring a massive crush on Diluc.

name: Pacal
description: The seasoned chief of the Children of Echoes (Nanatzcayan) tribe, who oversee gem mining and dance in the rocky canyons of Natlan.

name: Wayna
description: The adventurous chief of the Scions of the Canopy (Huitztlan) tribe, known for their courier work and high-altitude grapple acrobatics among the cliffs.

name: Amina
description: The diligent chief of the People of the Springs (Meztli) tribe, a warm resort community famous for hot springs and water sports.

name: Mutota
description: The chief of the Flower-Feather Clan (Tlalocan) tribe, whose members bond with aerial Qucusaurs to patrol the skies from high cliffs.

name: Biram
description: The masked chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind (Mictlan) tribe, known for their shamans, spiritual divination, and connection to the Iktomisauri.

name: Acatl
description: The masked chief of the Collective of Plenty (Teteocan) tribe, an athletic and warrior community renowned for wrestling and massive feasts near the volcano.

name: Netochka
description: A fiery Snezhnayan young woman encountered in Nod-Krai.

name: Zeitlind
description: A steady and reserved young woman from Mondstadt who explores the Temple of Space to retrace the steps of her missing older sister, Raumhilda.

name: Seamus
description: The strict and dedicated Seneschal of the Church of Favonius in Mondstadt.

name: Soraya
description: A scholarly Liyue researcher specializing in ancient ruins, stone tablets, and historical legends.

name: Tonia
description: Childe's innocent and loving younger sister who writes letters to him from their home in Snezhnaya.

name: Alrani
description: A chronically unlucky Sumeru Akademiya student who constantly finds herself in trouble during her field research.

name: Bao'er
description: A treasure-hunting researcher operating in Liyue with questionable motives regarding local artifacts.

name: Haypasia
description: A Sumeru Akademiya scholar who seeks to connect with the consciousness of the Dendro Archon through meditation.

name: Hosseini
description: A Sumeru researcher who frequently organizes academic events and studies involving unusual environmental phenomena.
